theme: Open day, one call, and Croatia a week out.
greeting: Good afternoon, Dan. The calendar's nearly clear — the move into the St. Pete Ranch house and a 3:30 call with Brunswick — which leaves real open hours to close out the Croatia list before you fly on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Conor Kehoe
needsAttention.detail: Conor's EA offered Monday Sep 7 or Tuesday Sep 8 for the PRI intro and is waiting on you to confirm. Monday is the safer pick, since you fly to Croatia on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Croatia bookings still open
needsAttention.detail: The last Cavtat night (Sep 19) and the St. Pete landing gap (Sep 20-22) are both P1 and still unbooked. Charter wifi is poor, so both have to be locked from dry land before you leave on the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: Today is the House 1 to House 2 changeover and the first test run for the rotating pantry bin. Worth building before you move so the first migration surfaces any gaps while there's still time to fix them.

schedule.title: St. Pete Ranch house (Sep 3-8)
schedule.detail: Changeover from the Kenwood place today

flagged.title: Stewardship Digest, issue one
flagged.detail: The first edition of a new sustainability-and-stewardship newsletter landed — a quick skim for your field.

inbox.noise: Otherwise it's airline-miles offers, retail promos, and a LinkedIn invite.

resolved.title: Logbook question answered
resolved.detail: Amy at Nautilus confirmed your ASA logbook comes after the course — nothing owed.

resolved.title: St. Pete Ranch check-in confirmed
resolved.detail: The host confirmed check-in for Sep 3-8; no reply needed.

recipe.title: Roast Monkfish
recipe.why: Autumn calls for something with more heft on the plate as the evenings draw in.

tasks.title: Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket — get it in writing
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: A clear morning with nothing on the calendar — the open hours before the afternoon.
The move into the St. Pete Ranch house, then a 3:30 call with Brunswick.
The girls are with you and Mike — a new kitchen to break in and dinner from scratch.
